snippet.title: Vision of Marathon | Bungie ViDoc
snippet.description:
Explore Marathon’s dark sci-fi world and survival extraction gameplay, as told by the development team. 

Marathon releases March 2026.
Learn more: https://bung.ie/450dGSQ 
 
Scavenge the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV as a bio-cybernetic Runner in a PvPvE survival extraction FPS from the creators of Halo and Destiny. 
 
Timestamps: 
Intro: 0:00 
The world: 1:33 
Gameplay intro: 3:20 
Visual immersion: 5:02 
Audio and music: 6:52 
Zones (Maps): 8:09 
Loot and weapons: 12:44 
Runner shells: 14:42 
Factions and contracts: 16:55 
The Codex: 18:44 
Marathon ship: 19:57 
Outro: 21:25 
 
Follow Marathon: 
Discord: https://discord.gg/marathonthegame 
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@marathonthegame 
Instagram: https://instagram.com/marathonthegame 
Twitter: https://x.com/marathonthegame 

Infil into the dark sci-fi world of Tau Ceti IV: A derelict colony rife with rival Runners, hostile UESC security forces, and unpredictable environments. Play with your crew, as a solo Runner, or form uneasy alliances with proximity chat. Scavenge, buildcraft, and take on greater PvPvE challenges – culminating with the derelict Marathon ship hanging above.
